abstract: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) is seeking public comments to assist in the preparation of its annual report to Congress on China's compliance with its obligations as a Member of the World Trade Organization (WTO). This notice includes the schedule for the submission of comments for the China report and a public hearing.
action: Request for comments and notice of public hearing.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: September 24, 2025, at 11:59 p.m. EDT: Deadline for submission of written comments, requests to testify, and summaries of written testimony.
title: Request for Comments and Notice of Public Hearing Concerning China's Compliance With WTO Commitments
